content: .{@-जनः@} .²1 a man, mankind. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon who had assumed the form of a conch-shell, and was slain by Kṛṣṇa; तस्मै प्रादाद्वरं पुत्रं मृतं पञ्चजनोदरात् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 3. 2</ls>. .²3 the soul. .²4 the five classes of beings; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} gods, men, Gandharvas, serpents and pitṛs; यस्मिन् पञ्च पञ्चजना आकाशश्च प्रतिष्ठितः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 17</ls>. .²5 the four primary castes of the Hindus (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य and शूद्र) with the Niṣādas or barbarians as the fifth (<ab>pl.</ab> in these two senses); (for a full exposition see <ls>Śārīrabhāṣya</ls> on <ls>Br. Sūtras 1. 4. 11-13</ls>). . ({@-नी@}) an assemblage of five persons.
